sloka: सम्प्रहृष्टा विनेदुस्ते नरास्तत्र सहस्रश: ।भरतस्यानुयातार: स्वर्गोयमिति चाब्रुवन् ॥ २.९१.६०॥
transliteration: samprahṛṣṭā vineduste narāstatra sahasraśa: ।bharatasyānuyātāra: svargoyamiti cābruvan ॥ 2.91.60॥

translations.english: We will neither return to Ayodhya, nor enter Dandaka (forest). May Bharata and Rama be happy.
